summary.text: Antonio Parkinson is a Democratic state representative from Tennessee House District 98 who has served since March 2011 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is a firefighter with the Shelby County Fire Department.

paragraphs.text: Antonio Parkinson served in the U.S. Marine Corps from July 1986 until July 1990 and was discharged as a corporal, according to Ballotpedia.
He is a firefighter with the Shelby County Fire Department.
He assumed office in Tennessee House District 98 on March 8, 2011.
For the 2023-2024 session Ballotpedia lists him on the Civil Justice, Education Administration and Finance, Ways, and Means committees.
